_units: Combined arms A6 (cg_brief queue item 2.7; docs/combined_arms.md 2.8, 9.2, 9.3): driving physics and terrain, read by VehicleDrive (scripts/vehicles/vehicle_drive.gd), Vehicle._wheel_forces, AavWater, ZoneBridges and TerrainRoute. Every number is Proposed. kg, metres, kW, kPa, km/h, seconds, litres, degrees. ground: per ground kind (ZoneTerrain.ground_at) the traction (a share of the tyre or track grip on asphalt, Vehicle.GRIP) for wheeled and tracked, the rolling resistance (a share of the weight), and a wheeled speed cap (2.8.1's table). power: drive force F = min(P x driveline_eff / max(v, min_v_ms), mu x N) less rolling resistance and the weight's share along the slope (2.8.2), accel_ms2 a cap on the net acceleration, top_speed_kmh the governor; soft ground (sand, mud, snow) scales the rolling resistance by sqrt(ground pressure / ref_kpa) within soft_scale. tracked: the yaw rate falls to half by half_rate_kmh (neutral steer at a standstill), scaled by the ground's tracked traction over turn_ref_traction (firm dirt: turn_deg_s is the firm-ground rate); a hard pivot (steer at least pivot_steer) above throw_kmh on rock or rubble, or on a side slope over throw_side_deg, throws a track at throw_per_s. rollover: the static tip angle is atan(half the wheel track / the centre of mass's height); the HUD warns at hud_share of it, the AI never crosses side slopes over ai_share of it and keeps its lateral acceleration under ai_lat_share of the tip's (g x half track / height); past it for confirm_s the vehicle is rolled over: its crew fall fall_m (belted seats half, open seats open_mult), it can't drive, and a tow from a vehicle of half its mass rights it (the tow job, then a pull of up to right_torque_g x its weight's turning moment until it stands within upright_deg). bog: a wheeled vehicle of ground_kpa or more on mud below bog_kmh for bog_s with the throttle open on a slope over bog_slope_deg is stuck until towed bog_tow_m. ford: deeper water than a model's ford_m (ground to surface under the hull) stalls the engine at once, damages it after damaged_s and destroys it after destroyed_s; water over its roof_m floods the crew compartment and the crew gets out; an amphibious hull holed below its waterline_m takes hole_lps a hole against pump_lps of bilge pumps and sinks at sink_l aboard; out of the water it drains at pump_lps and is dry drain_s after. current: the river pushes the immersed hull 0.5 x rho x cd x area x v_rel^2. aero: air drag 0.5 x rho x cd x frontal area x v^2 (in place of the engine's default linear damping, which had held every ground vehicle near 50 km/h). mlc: a vehicle's military load class is its mass in tonnes with its packages, rounded up (ZoneBridges.TYPES has the spans'). ai: the AI driver's look ahead (look_m plus look_s of travel) and how often it looks. budget_ms: the drive's host step per vehicle (vehicle range, 9.3: the physics step unchanged).
